description:
Luck be a Landlord APWorld.

Every symbol and normal item is randomized as an Archipelago unlock.
Essences stay available in-game as vanilla content, but are not AP unlocks
and do not have First Get checks.

Luck_be_a_Landlord_beta_1.description: This is a fully working build of the Luck be a Landlord mod to randomise items, symbols, essence into archipelgo to play with other games. It is a early build and might have bugs if you find any @Littlemuz on discord and tell me the problem and ill fix it when i get the chance
Luck_be_a_Landlord_beta_1.title: Beta Version 1.0

Updated_Beta_1.1.description:
This is an update of the apworld that i made and ai built mod this is to fix some logic errors that was left in the apworld. It also has backwards compatability with the other one so if you made an async with  the 1.0 version can use this with the mod.

Changed some filler to give coins instead of being useless just left in progressive nothing 
Added Starting Items to Buffs
Added Support to make goaling floors, goaling with shiny coins or goaling floors and shiny coins instead of just shiny coins
Added Support for Yamless Yaml with Universal Tracker

The next release I do should be the full release of the non ai mod unless something comes up that has a massive issue


If you just want the apworld without the mod to send to people or to use rather then always having the mod as well
https://github.com/Littlemuzz5/Ionium-Luck-be-a-Landlord/releases/tag/1.1 get it from here
